entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: lowerCall routes only the eight known value-reading date functions plus timestampFunctionName to lowerDateFn, and lowerSubqueryOverInstantTransform's own reorder path (lowerSubqueryIdentityDateReorder, #3692) gates on isDateComponentFn before ever calling projectDateFnOverInner directly. Both callers already restrict call.Func.Name to a name dateFnExpr recognises (or the timestamp spelling, excluded by this guard and taking the timestamp branch) before this function ever runs. A parseable wire query therefore cannot supply an unknown name here through either caller; the error is reachable only through a forged internal parser.Call in tests.

guard: if c.Func.Name != timestampFunctionName && dateFnExpr(c.Func.Name, nil, nil) == nil
